Madden NFL 27 · PC · Offline

Your Own Playbook, From Start to In-Game

The whole trip: download the project, design a playbook in Playbook Studio, turn it into a mod and a playbook save, and pick it in Madden. The first part is one-time setup. After that, every change is the same short loop.

Playbook Studiodesign in the browser→ Your foldersmall playbook files→ Export commandon the Madden PC→ Mod + savepbstudio.fbmod, PBOOKOFF→ Maddenpick your playbook

The mod holds your custom plays and sets. The save is the playbook itself: formations, play order, audibles. Madden needs both.

What You Need

Everything below goes on the Windows PC that has Madden 27. You can design on any computer, but the export runs there.

Madden NFL 27 (PC)Custom playbooks are offline only.
MMC Modding ToolsMMC Editor and MMC Mod Manager.
Google Chrome or Microsoft EdgePlaybook Studio saves into a folder on your PC, which only these browsers allow.
Node.js 20 or newernodejs.org, the LTS installer. Builds the playbook save.
.NET 8 SDKdotnet.microsoft.com. Builds the tool that writes the mod.

Part 1 · Set Up Once

About fifteen minutes, the first time only.

1
OnceMadden PC

Download the Project

  1. Open github.com/Hanson-Ma/M27-Playbook-Studio.
  2. Click the green Code button, then Download ZIP.
  3. Unzip it somewhere easy to find, for example Documents\Madden Playbooks.
This unzipped folder is the folder containing your playbook mod. Playbook Studio saves into it, and the export runs from it. It has app, data, playbooks and tools inside. Keep it in one place.
2
OnceMadden PC

One-Time Setup

  1. Open Madden once in MMC Editor and let it finish loading. That builds the cache the export reads the game from. Then close MMC Editor.
  2. Open PowerShell in your folder. In File Explorer, open the folder, click the address bar, type powershell and press Enter.
  3. Tell the tools where MMC Editor and Madden are installed (change both paths to yours), then close PowerShell and open it again so it picks them up:
    setx MMC_EDITOR_DIR "C:\Modding\MMC_Modding_Tools_v1.1.0.6\MMC_Editor_v1.1.0.6"
    setx MADDEN27_DIR "C:\Games\Madden NFL 27"
    The first path is the folder that holds FrostySdk.dll; the second, the folder with Madden's .exe.
  4. Build the mod tool (one command, a minute or two):
    dotnet build tools/PlayDump -c Release -p:EditorDir="$env:MMC_EDITOR_DIR"
  5. Add the key file. Put key1.local.bin in tools\PlayDump. It holds the key MMC Editor uses to read Madden's files. It isn't in the download, so get it from whoever shared this guide.
Already have Madden installed through MMC? If the export later says it can't find MMC Editor or the game, the paths in step 3 don't match. Fix them with setx and open a new PowerShell.

Part 2 · Make a Playbook

The part you'll repeat. Design anywhere; export on the Madden PC.

3
Every visitChrome or Edge

Open Playbook Studio and Pick Your Folder

  1. Open Playbook Studio in Chrome or Edge.
  2. Click Open Folder… and choose the folder containing your playbook mod: the one you unzipped in step 1, not a folder inside it.
  3. When the browser asks, allow it to view and edit the files. Pick Allow on every visit if offered and it opens straight away next time.
4
Every changeAny computer

Build Your Playbook

Work through the tabs at the top from left to right. Most people only need the first two, then Export.

  • Playbook: pick formations and sets, choose and order plays, set the four audibles per set.
  • Library: search every play in the game and add it.
  • Designer and Formations: make your own plays and sets.

Save with Ctrl+S. The ? button at the top right opens the full Playbook Studio guide for whatever screen you're on.

5
Every change

Check and Export

  1. Open the Export tab. It checks everything first.
  2. Ready to Export (green) means go. Red means something would break the build: click Show, then each problem to jump to the fix.
  3. Click Export. It saves every file and checks them again.
  4. Designing on another computer? Click Download .zip and unzip it into your folder on the Madden PC.
6
Every changeMadden PC · Madden closed

Run the Export Command

  1. Close Madden.
  2. Open PowerShell in your folder (address bar → powershell, like in step 2).
  3. Paste the command and press Enter:
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools\export.ps1 -Install

What it makes:

  • mods\pbstudio.fbmod: one mod with your custom plays and sets, plus stock plays the game normally hides from custom playbooks.
  • PBOOKOFF-<NAME>: one save per playbook, copied into Documents\Madden NFL 27\saves. The old copy is backed up to backups\.
7
Every changeMadden PC

Turn On the Mod in MMC Mod Manager

  1. Open MMC Mod Manager.
  2. First time: add mods\pbstudio.fbmod from your folder and tick it. After that: refresh it so the manager picks up the new build.
  3. Untick any other playbook mod: they change the same game file.
  4. Click Apply, then Launch.
Always launch through Mod Manager. Starting Madden any other way loads it without the mod, and custom plays go missing.
8
Every gameIn Madden

Pick Your Playbook in Madden

  1. Start an offline mode: Play Now, Franchise or practice.
  2. Where you choose your team's offensive playbook, pick your custom one. It shows up under the name you gave it (STUDIO shows as STUDIO).
  3. Kicking, punting and goal line come from the stock playbook, so special teams work as usual.
Offline only. Modded playbooks follow the MMC rules: never take them online.

Making Changes Later

Setup is done. Every change after that is the same loop.

  1. Edit in Playbook Studio, Ctrl+S
  2. Export tab → Export
  3. Close Madden, run the command
  4. Mod Manager: refresh, Apply, Launch
  5. Pick your playbook in game

If Something Goes Wrong

ProblemWhat to do
"Running scripts is disabled"Use the full command from step 6: -ExecutionPolicy Bypass allows it for that one run.
Can't find MMC Editor or the gameCheck the two setx paths from step 2, then open a new PowerShell window.
"Profile requires Key1"key1.local.bin is missing from tools\PlayDump (step 2).
"MMC Editor has a pending SDK update"After a Madden patch: start MMC Editor once so it updates and rebuilds its cache, close it, run the command again.
The command says a play or set can't be foundExport again in Playbook Studio and fix what it lists. Make sure the Madden PC has your latest files.
A play is missing in the gameIt needs the mod: refresh pbstudio.fbmod in Mod Manager, Apply, and launch through Mod Manager.
The playbook doesn't show upCheck the command ended with Done and that PBOOKOFF-<NAME> is in Documents\Madden NFL 27\saves. Restart Madden.
The game still has the old versionClose Madden, run the command again, refresh the mod in Mod Manager, Apply.
The start screen says it isn't your playbook folderYou picked a folder inside it, or the one above it. Pick the folder with data, playbooks and tools directly inside.
Playbook Studio and the export tools are a fan project for Madden NFL 27 on PC. Back up your saves folder before your first export.
